layout.arrangement: Figure-only slide. Maroon outer frame on white; yellow badge '51' upper-right; white inner panel with maroon border containing a scatter plot with decision-field dot grid (blue left, red right/bottom), two large marker clusters (blue upper-left, red U/crescent lower-right), dark zero-lines; black capture bar along bottom.

regions.name: chart
regions.content: Axes/data region with grid, zero-lines, dot fields, clusters

visual_elements.description: Axes box; x ticks -10,0,10,20,30,40,50; y ticks -10,0,10,20,30,40; light-gray grid #D9D9D9; tick ink #3B3B3B; only ticks readable
Dark-gray zero-lines #7F7F7F: vertical at data x=0, y 0->30 [0.325,0.268,0.327,0.662]; horizontal at data y=0, x 0->~43 [0.325,0.660,0.740,0.663]
Background dotted field, blue #0000FF left region [0.325,0.268,0.615,0.662]
Background dotted field, red #FF0000 right/bottom region [0.460,0.268,0.740,0.662] plus right of top rows

typography_notes: Sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like). Tick labels ~10-11 pt regular #3B3B3B; y right-aligned, x centered; minus sign on '-10'. Badge '51' bold ~16 pt black centered. No title/body.
